meta.name: architecture-extract
meta.description: Convert raw project structure into clear architectural understanding — module boundaries, data flows, service relationships, and architectural patterns. Activate after codebase-scan during Bootstrap.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将项目结构转化为清晰的架构理解
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果接手大型项目后需要快速掌握其架构设计。
copy.tagline_en: Convert project structure into clear architectural understanding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly grasp the architecture of a large codebase.

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude自动分析你的项目代码结构，输出一份简明架构说明，包含模块边界、数据流、服务关系以及架构模式等关键信息。
howto.when: 在Claude启动阶段，执行完代码扫描（codebase-scan）后自动触发。

say.text: 分析当前项目的模块边界和架构模式。
查看项目的数据流向和服务关系。
say.note: Claude会生成数据流和服务关系说明。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to analyze your project's code structure and produce a concise architecture summary, including module boundaries, data flows, service relationships, and architectural patterns.
howto.when_en: Automatically activated after codebase-scan during the Bootstrap initialization phase.

say_en.text: Analyze the module boundaries and architecture pattern of the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will output an architecture summary.

say_en.text: Show me the data flows and service relationships in the project.
say_en.note: Claude will generate data flow and service relationship descriptions.
